findings.proposal: (a) Add the biome name and Terrain.Tag to each campaign-map column header ('CINDER REACH · MAGMA · VENTS') beside the region name, colour-redundant like the class mark; (b) split Stats' BURN attribution by ignition source (vent / barrel / grenade / incendiary / enemy fire) — report-only, inert; (c) price one vent lever CRN-paired (VentBurnTurns 2 -> 1, or exempt the first step onto a ford) against the same slot sets.
findings.acceptance: FITTEST leg for the map header at all four text scales (no overprint with the node labels — src/Hud.cs 'campaign-map labels can't overprint' contract); SIGHTLINE_MAPCOL screenshot; inert_diff on the BURN split (zero non-harness fields move); a 40-campaign paired round per slot set with the byBiome MAGMA row and the vent-burn split quoted with base commit and n.

findings.title: The four most distinctive 'contest' archetypes are the rarest bodies in the game (BOMBARD 0.8%, WARBRINGER 1.6%, PIKEMAN 1.8%, CUSTODIAN 2.1%), and CUSTODIAN is a dead mechanic on six of eight objectives
findings.evidence: L4 spawn tally (enemyComposition summed over 48 chunks, 30,408 spawns): BOMBARD 231, WARBRINGER 481, PIKEMAN 543, CUSTODIAN 624 vs SCOUT 3586 / GRUNT 3415. Cascade windows 3%/2%/3%/2% at src/Mission.cs:1048-1062; one-per-mission caps siegeSpawned/bannerSpawned (src/Mission.cs ~712-716); Wardens BOMBARD only m3+ (src/Mission.cs:1142). CUSTODIAN's verb is re-locking a terminal or re-arming a blown charge (Ai.cs:299 -> Game.DoRelock); src/Mission.cs MakeFinaleRetinue comment: 'a keeper has no terminal/charge to re-lock — a dead mechanic on the one map it would ship on'. SpawnEnemies receives `sabotage` and `defend` flags but not whether the objective has a terminal (src/Mission.cs:637-640), so it cannot gate the keeper. L4 lethality: CUSTODIAN 43 soldier kills over 624 spawns.
findings.problem: The verbs that make a fight read differently — position (artillery), morale (banner), movement (lane), progress (keeper) — together appear in roughly one mission in three, and CUSTODIAN's 624 spawns are mostly a 5-HP SMG grunt with a padlock silhouette. A 10-run player may never have watched a banner hold a wavering pod.
findings.proposal: (1) Gate CUSTODIAN at spawn on a progress objective: pass `bool progressObj = terminal.HasValue || sabotageObj` into SpawnEnemies and, when false, resolve its r-window to PIKEMAN (Wardens) / WARBRINGER (Legion) / SCREENER (Syndicate) instead — same `r`, zero extra draws. (2) Relax the WARBRINGER cap to one per POD on m4+ (BannerRange is Chebyshev 4 on an 18x11 board; two auras cannot blanket it). (3) Add 'ANCHORED' / 'ARTILLERY' words to Run.EnemyHint (src/Run.cs:1845) so the fork tells you a banner or artillery node lies ahead.
findings.acceptance: A spawn-census self-test leg (extend AICOVTEST or CLASSTEST): 500 Hack/Sabotage builds per faction field CUSTODIAN within its window, 500 Eliminate/Evac/Defend builds field zero; PAIRTEST byte-identical if the re-route consumes the same r (assert on a pinned slot); a 40-campaign paired batch showing the ENEMY COMPOSITION rows moving as declared and byObjective unchanged where CUSTODIAN was inert. CODEXTEST green; FITTEST on the hint string.

findings.title: Twelve of 22 hostiles carry the same SMG and four archetype pairs are stat twins differing by one Ai.Plan weight — HUNTER/STRIKER, SCOUT/HOUND, GRUNT/LANCER, SPOTTER/SCREENER
findings.evidence: Stat lines src/Mission.cs:996-1065: HUNTER (Smg, 5 HP, 60 aim, mob 9) vs STRIKER (Smg, 4, 60, 9) — the only differences are `owEnd 9 vs 26` (src/Ai.cs:856) and never-retreat (src/Ai.cs:469-472); SCOUT (Smg,4,58,8) vs HOUND (Smg,3,56,9) — HOUND's isolation targeting (src/Ai.cs:223); GRUNT (Rifle,5,60,6) vs LANCER (Rifle,7,58,5) — adjacency bonus (src/Ai.cs:832); SPOTTER (Smg,5,48,6) vs SCREENER (Smg,5,46,6). Weapon census of the 22: SMG 12 / Rifle 4 / LMG 3 / Shotgun 2 / Sniper 1. L4 soldier kills per spawn: STRIKER 0.093 vs HUNTER 0.107; HOUND 0.091 vs SCOUT 0.054; LANCER 0.134 vs GRUNT 0.096 — twins in outcome as well as statline. The threat card (Hud.DrawThreatCard) prices expected damage from the weapon band, so twins forecast identically.
findings.problem: The bestiary reads as ~14 threats, not 22; a twin's only differentiator is an AI tendency the player sees after it fires, and nothing in Combat.ComputeOdds, the tooltip or the incoming-fire card distinguishes a JACKAL from a WRAITH standing on the same tile.
findings.proposal: Give each junior twin ONE rules-axis hook that ComputeOdds/ShotAnim can badge and the Codex can name, rather than another AI weight: HUNTER — flank shots carry +crit (a Cls-keyed AddCrit like Trait.Killer, badge 'JACKAL'), HOUND — a hit applies Bleed (mirror the Boon.Venom path on the hostile side), LANCER — +1 Armor while adjacent to another LANCER (the phalanx made mechanical; Unit.Armor exists), SPOTTER left as is (its paint is already a rule). Update the four bestiary blurbs so the manual names the rule.
findings.acceptance: COMBATTEST legs: HUNTER crit delta only on a flanked target; LANCER armor only with an adjacent LANCER; HOUND applies Bleed on hit and not on graze; TRUTHTEST parity for each new badge (W9's 'a badge that lies' gate); CODEXTEST green; AICOVTEST decision mix unchanged. A 40-campaign paired batch showing per-spawn lethality of the twins diverging in soldierDeathsByEnemy with base commit and n.

findings.title: The arena deck is objective- and shape-blind, and two authored pairs are ~88% tile-identical — 17 of 35 arenas have no elevation, 5 have authored barrels, 8 are left-right mirrors
findings.evidence: src/Mission.cs:1752 `PickLayout(missionNum) => DeckPick(DeckSeed, missionNum)` — the only inputs are seed and mission number; DeployFor (src/Mission.cs:78) likewise. Parsed census of src/Maps.cs Layouts (35): no elevation 17 (PILLARS, FOXHOLES, THICKET, CHASM, HOOK, GRID, CONDUIT, PALISADE, WISHBONE, APPROACH, KILLBOX, TRENCHES, GARRISON, REFINERY, CRUCIBLE, COLONNADE, ENTRENCHED); tier-2 9; barrels 5; LR-mirror-symmetric 8; closest pairs ZIGGURAT/FORGE 88.9% identical tiles (same footprint, FORGE is the MAGMA-tinted twin), GARRISON/REFINERY 88.4%, HOOK/GARRISON 88.4%. Hint pull: the 8 BiomeLayoutHint arenas took 38.9% of L4's 2690 authored missions (THICKET 6.1%, CAUSEWAY 6.0%, DONJON 5.6%, CRUCIBLE 5.5%, REDANS 5.0%) vs a uniform 2.9%. CAUTION: per-arena n in L4 is quantized by 80 CRN slot seeds (APPROACH n=15, THICKET n=164), so it is not evidence of generator bias; EXPOSURETEST (DEVLOG:4723, 4000 seeds, 35/35 for every shape) is the instrument.
findings.problem: Defend on COLONNADE (a long gallery with no strongpoint) and Defend on DONJON are the same deal; Escort across CHASM's cover river and ENVELOP on a corner-heavy map are dealt as often as anything else. Arena variety is not where breadth runs out for a 5th-run player (~24-48 authored missions seen by run 10), but the arena never MATCHES the fight, so the same objective on the same arena class recurs without the set-piece pairing the arena comments describe.
findings.proposal: Add a small tag table beside Layouts (`Maps.Tags[idx]`: HOLD / ASSAULT / OPEN / HAZARD / VERTICAL, from the existing arena comments) and a soft objective-aware pull in DeckPick at the same 25% weight and zero-draw derivation as the biome hint: Defend/Rescue -> HOLD, Decapitate -> VERTICAL, Sabotage -> OPEN, Evac/Escort -> not HAZARD. Differentiate the two 88% twins (give FORGE a distinct footprint or fold it into ZIGGURAT's MAGMA skin). Pure derivation, but it changes which world a seed deals: its own wave, R0diag first.
findings.acceptance: EXPOSURETEST extended: over 4000 seeds P(HOLD arena | Defend) >= 40% while every arena stays reachable on every objective and shape; a byArena x objective cross-tab added to the report; PAIRTEST byte-identical on a pinned slot before and after (the pull is Hash3-only); SIGHTLINE_MAP screenshots of any edited arena; connectivity-reject rate stays ~0 in the ARENA FUNNEL.

findings.title: ARID SOFT SAND — the S-cost mechanical biome: a CostMap-only slow tile, the inverse of ice, symmetric by construction
findings.evidence: src/Grid.cs:478-484 CostMap already branches on GroundKind per step (`Ice` -> Terrain.IceStepOrth/Diag, `Vent` -> += VentStepExtra); src/Terrain.cs:60-64 the ice constants; StampPatches (src/Terrain.cs ~150) is a reusable blob walker; V3 draws an ARID 'dune ridge' feature (DEVLOG:4353). ARID is a paint room asserted by BIOMETEST (src/Game.Harness.cs:3901) and mid-pack in L4 byBiome (79.9%, n=422). The Codex FIELD CRAFT block for ground rules is gated on Terrain.Enabled and takes one Add() per rule (src/Codex.cs ~130-155).
findings.problem: The movement axis has only a fast lane; there is no slow ground anywhere in the game, so 'fight around it or crawl through it' is a decision no board asks. It is also the safest first paint-to-mechanic conversion because it has no hazard, no sight effect and no cover interaction to mis-price.
findings.proposal: GroundKind.Sand for ARID (index 1): step cost orth 3 / diag 4 (SandStepOrth/Diag as static ints so BIOMETEST can pin them), nothing else; stamped as 3-4 lobed patches with a budget ~40 via StampPatches; the move overlay shrinks the same way the ice bulge grows. Tag 'SOFT SAND', rule 'a dune costs half a step MORE - slow ground for both sides'. Autopilot needs no term (reach comes from the shared cost map, exactly as C4 found for ice).
findings.acceptance: BIOMETEST: flip ARID's paint assertion deliberately; legs: CostMap onto sand == 3/4; a Mobility-4 soldier's reachable set on a sand board is a strict subset of the flag-off set on the same board; density pin printed each sweep; SIGHTLINE_BIOMEMECH=0 restores. PAIRTEST byte-identical. Screenshot SIGHTLINE_FORCEBIOME=1 SIGHTLINE_SHOT=760 with the codex row visible via SIGHTLINE_CODEXTAB=0. 40-campaign paired round, ARID byBiome row vs paint control.

findings.title: Field events never touch the NEXT FIGHT — 19 outcome kinds, 18 of them roster/economy state; no event changes a board, an opening or a force
findings.evidence: src/Events.cs:18-44 EventOutcomeKind: Intel, HealSoldier, WoundSoldier, GambleIntel, GrantWeaponMod, GrantBonusPerk, GrantGrenades, GrantArmor, Recruit, GrantTrait, AddHeat, GrantBoon, Nothing, GrantScar, CureScar, Salvage, GrantPrep, RankKills, ReleaseSoldier — only GrantPrep reaches a fight, as an aim modifier. All 17 events were seen in L4 (993 choice picks, 'cache' least at 24, 'informant' most at 101), so exposure is no longer the issue ROADMAP's 'Event exposure' item describes. The pins that would let an event shape a fight already exist: Mission.ForcedDeploy (src/Mission.cs:45), MissionCard.EnemyDelta/StatDelta (src/Run.cs CardForNode), BiomeLayoutHint (src/Mission.cs:224).
findings.problem: Every event is '+N intel versus a roster trade'; the '?' node is a shop with flavour text. Nothing a player chooses between missions changes what the next board looks like, which is the cheapest place in the loop to buy run-to-run combination variety (DESIGN §3.F).
findings.proposal: Append 2-3 EventOutcomeKinds (the kind is not persisted, but the pending modifier must be: one new nullable Run field + SaveGame DTO leg): NextOpening (an ambush warning -> the next fight deals PINCER or ENVELOP via the ForcedDeploy path for one mission), NextForceTrim (bribe the garrison: -2 bodies next fight, +1 heat for the run), NextArenaPull (a local guide: the next fight pulls the biome's themed arena at 100%). Author 2 events using them ('AMBUSH INTEL', 'THE GARRISON TAKES BRIBES'). Consumed once in SetupMission and cleared.
findings.acceptance: EVENTTEST legs: apply -> the next SetupMission reads the modifier exactly once and clears it; save/load round-trip carries it (SAVETEST DTO fingerprint updated and pasted); the mission after is unaffected; autopilot's event valuation (Game.EventChoiceValue) prices the new kinds (FireWeight test rows). SIGHTLINE_EVENTID=<new id> screenshot at 4 text scales (FITTEST event-card leg). Autoplay x3 clean.

findings.title: Every ground mechanic is met for the first time on a live mission — the TRAINING OP is pinned to STEEL and there is no just-in-time tip for UNDERGROWTH / ICE / VENTS
findings.evidence: DEVLOG §C4 'What I did NOT do' item 7: 'The mechanics are not taught by the tutorial/drill. The drill is pinned to STEEL, so a new player meets a mechanic for the first time on a live mission with only the briefing card, the banner and the codex.' Maps.TrainingArena (src/Maps.cs ~640) has no ground; FEATURES.md lists the 10 FIELD TIP cards (BRACE/STABILIZE/RELOAD/GRENADE/HUNKER/SHOVE/VAULT/DRAG/FOCUS/ITEM) — none is a ground rule; the biome briefing line is one sentence (src/Terrain.cs Rule) that auto-fades in 11 s and clears the moment the combat log has an entry. Not listed as an open item in ROADMAP.
findings.problem: The only content axis that changes the RULES of a fight (cover / movement / sight) has the weakest teaching layer of any verb; with more biomes going mechanical (findings above) this gap compounds.
findings.proposal: Add three FIELD TIP cards to Game.UpdateFieldTips fired once per profile the first time the squad deploys on a mechanical biome (precondition: BiomeIndex mechanical AND the tip bit unset), reusing the existing bitmask in display.json and the existing tip chrome; text from Terrain.Rule so it cannot drift. Optionally stamp a small undergrowth patch into the TrainingArena's centre lane as lesson 2b (cover) — cheap but it touches the drill's turn-budget fallbacks, so do the tips first.
findings.acceptance: TUTTEST legs: each of the three tips fires exactly once per profile, only on its biome, never while a lesson/briefing card owns the slot, and the seen-bits round-trip through display.json; SIGHTLINE_TIP screenshots for all three at the four text scales (FITTEST tip-card leg); SIGHTLINE_FORCEBIOME=3/2/7 with SIGHTLINE_FIRSTRUN=1 to photograph each.

findings.title: The balance report has no per-RUN content-exposure block, and the archived per-arena rows are quantized by 80 CRN seeds — nobody can currently say how many archetypes, biomes or kits a campaign fields
findings.evidence: L4 report DECK EXPOSURE prints only 'distinct authored arenas/run 3.40 mean' (docs/measurements/l4/L4-h0-b0.report.txt:127-129); ENEMY COMPOSITION is a spawn tally (src/Stats.cs:1104-1112) with no per-run distinct count; byBiome is mission-level (DEVLOG:11439 'No per-biome ladder'); across the 48 L4 chunks per-arena n ranges 15 (APPROACH) to 164 (THICKET) purely because the batch replays 80 slot seeds x 2 policies x 6 rungs, so those rows cannot be read as generator exposure. Content findings in this docket (skirmish roster, mid-boss cadence, biome cycle, rare contest archetypes) all had to be derived by hand from code and JSON.
findings.problem: Without a per-run distinct-content measure, no wave can prove it widened the deal, and the next reader will re-mis-read L4's byArena as arena bias.
findings.proposal: Add a CONTENT EXPOSURE block to Stats (report + aggregate JSON, report-only so it is inert): per campaign, distinct archetype classes fielded, distinct biomes and mechanical-room count, distinct arenas, distinct events, mid-boss/finale kits met, deployment shapes met, with mean/min/max over the batch; and an EXPOSURETEST leg that samples 4000 fresh seeds (not the CRN slots) for biome-sequence pair coverage and archetype first-appearance mission. Add a README note in docs/measurements/l4 that byArena is seed-quantized.
findings.acceptance: The block prints in SIGHTLINE_BALANCE=10 under xvfb and appears in the JSON; inert_diff.sh against the base binary shows zero non-harness fields moved; EXPOSURETEST prints archetypes-per-run mean and biome-pair coverage and is routed through the sweep's verdict so a regression fails the gate.
